heading: Compliance with other registration statutes
lead: Compliance with the registration provisions of this subchapter does not relieve any person from compliance with any other applicable registration statute.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was not enacted as part of the Internal Security Act of 1950 which comprises subchapters I to III of this chapter.
